svg.title: The Mercury 3 verification stack
svg.desc: Diagram of four stacked evidence layers for Inception's Mercury 3 launch: the headline claim (Inception's blog and press release), Inception's own benchmark table (eight wins of twelve at medium effort), independent checks (Artificial Analysis had no measurement as of October 20; OpenRouter's live median was about 243 tokens per second; a community harness found real speed but competitive, not frontier, quality), and your own measurement.

text.tspan: Each layer of the launch claim needs a different check.
Inception's own runs — no harness details
harness: real speed, competitive not frontier.
Run your task on your data;
The headline is a vendor best case — what you see live will differ.
Promo prices (50% off) have no published end date.
